title: Frog Unicorn Vortex
description: A vibrant surreal painting of a green frog with large golden eyes and a long spiraled purple-and-white unicorn horn emerging from its forehead. The frog is centered in a swirling vortex of green, purple, and turquoise brushstrokes with musical notes and glowing particles flowing around it.
